title: TRIBE Review MVP
summary: A local web application for analyzing Meta video advertisements using the TRIBE v2 behavioral inference model. It translates raw brain-response predictions into a visual review format to help optimize video structure and creative hooks.
research_notes: Requires NVIDIA GPU (6GB+ VRAM) and Windows; specifically designed to reverse-engineer viral video hooks and structural patterns.

evolution.summary: Based on Meta's TRansformative Inference for Behavioral Evaluation (TRIBE) v2 framework; the tool includes local Whisper transcription and Ollama-based editing recommendations for creative strategy.
